title: A Scalable Learned Iterative Solver for Nonlinear MPC via Temporal Decomposition
abstract: arXiv:2610.13480v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) can be applied to large nonlinear systems with complex objectives while enforcing constraints, but the cost of solving the underlying optimization problems limits real-time application for systems with fast dynamics or many states. Neural networks can reduce this online cost by approximating the control law, but may violate constraints and typically require many precomputed optimizer solutions for training. The learning-based iterative solver for constrained optimization (LISCO) instead learns to predict primal-dual steps toward satisfaction of the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions through self-supervised training without precomputed solutions, but its dense, monolithic architecture grows with the prediction horizon. translated_title: 基于时间分解的非线性模型预测控制可扩展学习迭代求解器
translated_abstract: 非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）可以应用于具有复杂目标的大型非线性系统，同时施加约束条件，但求解底层优化问题的计算成本限制了其在快动态或高维状态系统中的实时应用。神经网络可以通过逼近控制律来降低在线计算成本，但可能违反约束，且通常需要大量预先计算的优化器解用于训练。基于学习的约束优化迭代求解器（LISCO）则通过自监督训练学习预测原始-对偶步以满足Karush-Kuhn-Tucker（KKT）条件，无需预先计算的解，但其密集的整体式网络架构会随预测时域的增长而扩大。我们通过在求解器架构中利用问题的时间结构消除了这种对时域的依赖，使网络规模与时域无关，同时……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过在LISCO求解器架构中利用问题的时间分解结构，使神经网络规模与预测时域无关，从而实现了对大型非线性系统可扩展的实时非线性模型预测控制。
en_tdlr: This paper exploits temporal decomposition in the LISCO solver architecture, making the network size independent of the prediction horizon and enabling scalable real-time nonlinear MPC for large nonlinear systems.
